# Shrub leaf spray

Original project texture generated with the built-in imagegen tool on
2026-10-14. Source: `shrub-leaf-spray.png`, RGBA cutout. The tracked Environment
generator packs this leaf artwork above the branch bark region; generation
does not run during game builds. No external model or game asset was imported.

Prompt:

> Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: original game foliage cutout texture, a reusable leafy twig spray for a generated 3D bush inspired by the natural leafy look of early-2000s tropical FPS environments. Generate one square texture on genuinely transparent background. A short thin naturally branching brown twig enters from bottom center and divides into 3-4 slender sprays carrying about 18-24 individually readable broad oval-pointed green leaves, varied sizes and directions. The foliage fills most of the square with irregular edges and visible transparent gaps between leaves. Each leaf has natural fine veins, subtly curled edges, varied forest-green/olive-green colour, soft diffuse neutral illumination. Botanical realism and crisp texture detail, no stylized polygons, no toy look. Front/three-quarter orthographic botanical specimen, flat diffuse albedo suitable for game lighting, no strong baked shadows, no cast shadow, no environment or ground, no flower, no pot, no labels, no watermark. Keep all leaves inside the frame with 3 percent transparent border. One leaf cluster/sprig, not an entire bush or a tree. Transparent pixels surrounding and between leaves.
